v: apuMs
pu॰ na pumAn na॰ ta॰ । 1 napuMsake klIve । “pumAn puMso'Dike Sukre strI BavatyaDike striyAH । same'pumAn puMstriyO vA kzIRe'lpe ca viparyyaya iti” manuH ।
m: अ-पुंस् (nom. -पुमान्) m. not a man, a eunuch, Mn. iii, 49, &c.
a: अपुंस् — m. (˚पुमान्) Not a man, a eunuch; Ms. 3. 49.

v: apuMskA
strI nAsti pumAn yasyAH uraHpraBftitvAt kap । 1 patiSUnyastriyAm । ‘nApuMskAsIti me matiriti’ BawwiH ।
m: अ-पुंस्का f. without a husband, Bhaṭṭ.
a: अपुंस्का — f. A woman without a husband; नापुंस्कासीति मे मतिः Bk. 5. 70.

m: अ-पुंस्—त्व n. the state of a eunuch.
a: अपुंस्त्वं — The state of a eunuch, impotent state.

v: apuRya
na॰ na puRyaM viroDe na॰ ta॰ । 1 pApe । na॰ ba॰ । 2 puRyaSUnye tri॰ ।
m: अ-पुण्य mfn. impure, wicked.
a: अपुण्य — a. Not virtuous or holy, wicked, bad; ˚कृत् one who does not perform meritorious deeds, or who commits unrighteous deeds.

v: apuRyakft

tri॰ puRyaM na karoti apuRyaM pApaM vA karoti । tAcCInye kvip 1 puRyAkarttari 2 pApakAriRi ca । “kzattriyaScEva vfttasTovESyaH SUdrastayEva ca । yaH pibet kapilAkzIraM na tatonyostyapuRyakft” Apa॰ smftiH ।
m: अ-पुण्य—कृत् mfn. acting wickedly, wicked.
अ-पुञ्ज m. a spark, L.

s: strI, (nAsti pucCamagraBAgo yasyAH sA, wAp .) SiMSapAvfkzaH । iti SabdacandrikA ॥ (tri, lANgUlahInaH । SiKarahInaH .)
v: apucCA
strI nAsti pucCamagraM yasyAH । 1 SiKarahIne SiMSapAvfkze । 2 pucCahIne tri॰ ।
m: अ-पुच्छा f. the tree Dalbergia, Śiś.
अ-पुच्छ mfn. tailless
a: अपुच्छ — a. Without a tail. --च्छा N. of a tree (Mar. शीसु).

m: अ-पुनः-प्राप्य mfn. irrecoverable.

v: apunar
avya॰ na punaH na॰ ta॰ । punarvAraBinne sakfdarTe “anAnukftyamapunaScakAra” f॰ 10, 68, 10 ।
m: अ-पुनर् ind. not again, only once, RV. x, 68, 10.
a: अपुनर् — ind. Not again, once for all, for ever. --Comp. --अन्वय a. not returning; dead. --आदानं not taking back or again. --आवृत्तिः f. ‘nonreturn’, exemption of the soul from further transmigration, final beatitude. --प्राप्य a. irrecoverable. --भवः {1} not being born again (of diseases also). {2} final beatitude. {3} knowledge of the Supreme Soul which tends to this step. {4} a person released from metempsychosis.

m: अ-पुनर्—आभाव (अ-प्˚), m. not appearing again, MaitrS.
अ-पुनर्—आवर्तन, n. or अ-पुनर्—आवृत्ति, f. final exemption from life or transmigration, Jain.; Up.

v: apunarAvftti
strI na punaH AvfttiH saMsAragatiryataH 5 ba॰ । nirvARamuktO “na sa punarAvarttate” iti SrutestayAtvam । 6 ba॰ । punargamanaSUnye tri॰ । arTABAve avyayI॰ । punarAvfttyaBAve avya॰ ।

m: अ-पुनर्—भाव m. id.
अ-पुनर्—भाविन् mfn. the last, Veṇīs.
अ-पुनर्—√ भू not to recover consciousness, ŚBr.

s: puM, (na punarBavati na punarutpadyate'smAt, na punar + BU + apAdAne ap, mayUravyaMsakAditvAt samAsaH .) muktiH । kEvalyaM । iti hemacandraH ॥ punarjanmABAvaH । yaTA, -- “hetO liNge praSamane rogARAmapunarBave । jYAnaM caturviDaM yasya sa rAjArho BizaktamaH” ॥ iti carakaH ॥ (karttari aci tu punarjanmaSUnyaH muktaiti yAvat .)
v: apunarBava

pu॰ na punarBavati saMsAraM Bajate'smin BU--ADAre ap । 1 mokze । karaRe ap na॰ ta॰ । 2 punarBavABAva hetO tattvajYAne aBAvArTe na॰ ta॰ । punarutpattyaBAve pu॰ 3 praSamane nivAraRe, “rogARAmapunarBave । jYAnaM caturviDaM yasyeti” vEdyakam । nAsti punarBavaH punarutpattirasya 4 punarjanmaSUnye tattvajYAnavati mukte ।
m: अ-पुनर्—भव m. not occurring again, Car.
exemption from further transmigration, final beatitude, BhP.
अ-पुनर्—अन्वय mfn. not returning, dead.
अ-पुनर्—दीयमान (अ-पुनर्-) mfn. not being given back, AV. xii, 5, 44.
अ-पुनर्—उक्त, n. or अ-पुनर्—उक्ति, f. no (superfluous) repetition.

v: apurARa
tri॰ viroDe na॰ ta॰ । 1 purARaBinne navIne ।
m: अ-पुराण or अ-पुरातन mfn. not old, modern, new.
अ-पुरोगव mfn. without a leader, AV. xx, 135, 7; AitBr.
अ-पुरोहित अस्, m. not a Purohita, ŚBr.
अ-पुरोहित mfn. without a Purohita, AitBr.
अ-पुरो-ऽनुवाक्यक mfn. without a Puronuvākyā, ŚBr.
अ-पुरोरुक्क mfn. without a Puroruc, ŚBr.
अ-पुरु—˚षाभिवीत (अ-प्˚), mfn. not impelled by men, ŚBr.
अ-पुरु—˚षापराध m. not an offence of the person, Gaut.
अ-पुरुषार्थ m. a rite which is not for the benefit of the sacrificer
not the chief object of the soul.
अ-पुरुष mfn. unmanly.
a cruel man or servant (of Yama), Jātakam.
a: अपुरुष — a. Not manlike, unmanly. --Comp. --अर्थः {1} a rite or ceremony which is not in the interests of the doer. {2} not the principal object of the soul.

m: अपुस् n. v.l. for वपुस्, Naigh.
a: अपुस् — n. Ved. Shape, body = वपुस्

v: aputra

puMstrI nAsti putroyasya । 1 ajAtaputre 2 mftaputre ca । “aputreREva karttavyaH putrapratiniDiH sadeti” smftiH “nAputrasya loko'sti” SrutiH । “aputrA SayanaM BarttuH pAlayantI vrate sTiteti” vfhanmanuH । “aputrasyEva yA kanyA sEvapiRqapradA Bavediti” smftiH putrapadaYca putrapOtraprapOtraparamiti dAyaBAgAdayaH vA kap । aputrako'pyuktArTe ।
m: अ-पुत्र m. not a son, ŚBr. xiv
अ-पुत्र mf(आ)n. sonless, ŚBr. &c.
a: अपुत्रः — Not a son. --a., --पुत्रकः ( ˚त्रिका f.) Having no son or heir.

m: अ-पुत्रक mf(इका)n. sonless, Kathās.; Daś.
अ-पुत्र—ता (अपुत्र-) f. sonlessness, ŚBr.

a: अपुत्रिका — The daughter of a sonless father, who herself has no male child; one who is not appointed by her father to beget male issue for him on failure of a son; cf. अकृता. --कः The father of such a daughter.

m: अ-पुत्रिक m. the father of a daughter not fit to be adopted as a son because of her not having any male offspring.
अ-पुत्रिय mfn. sonless, childless, ŚāṅkhGṛ. &c.
अ-पुत्र्य sonless, childless, MantraBr.
अपुवाय Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to get ill, become spoiled, TS. (cf. अन्वर्त्.)
अपुवाय, ˚यते, see अप्वा (p. 59, col. 3).
अपुष m. (said to be fr. √ आप्) fire, L.
अपुष mfn. ill, sick (in this meaning prob. fr. अ + √ 2. पुष्), L.
अ-पुष्कल mfn. ‘not eminent’, mean, low, Veṇīs.; Hcar.
empty of meaning, shallow, flat, Hcar.
a: अपुष्कल — a. 1 Not much. --2 Mean, low, base.

v: apuzpa
avya॰ puzpasyABAvaH avyayI॰ । puzpABAve । “tErapuzpAt vanaspati” rityamaraH apuzpAdityatra paYcamyA nAmBAvaH ।
m: अ-पुष्प mf(आ)n. not flowering, RV. &c.
अ-पुष्प (अस्), m. the glomerous fig tree.
a: अपुष्प — a. Flowerless, not flowering. --ष्पः The glomerous fig-tree. --Comp. --फल, --फलद a. bearing fruits without flowering, having neither fruits nor flowers. (-लः, -दः) {1} the jack tree (Mar. फणस) Artocarpus Integrifolia. {2} the glomerous fig-tree (उदुंबर).

m: अ-पुष्प—फल or अ-पुष्प—फल-द, m. ‘bearing fruits without flowering’, ‘having neither flowers nor fruits’, the jack tree, Artocarpus Integrifolia, the glomerous fig tree.

s: puM, (apuzpaM, puzpaM vinA PalaM dadAti, apuzpaPala + dA + karttari kaH, upapadasamAsaH ॥) panasavfkzaH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ puzpavyatirekajAtaPalavfkzamAtraM ॥ (ahetukaPaladAtari triM)
v: apuzpaPalada
pu॰ apuzpaM puzpABAve'pi PalaM dadAti dA--ka । 1 puzpaM vinA Palade panase taTABUte udumbarAdO ca । upacArAt 2 ahetukaPaladAtari karttari tri॰ ।

m: अ-पुष्टार्थ mfn. (in rhet.) of irrelevant purport or meaning, Sāh.
अ-पुष्टार्थ—त्व (n.)

v: apuzwa
tri॰ puza--karmmaRi kta na॰ ta॰ । 1 akftapozaRe yasya puzwirna kftA tasmin ।
m: अ-पुष्ट mfn. unnourished, lean
soft, L.
invalid, unimportant, Kpr.
a: अपुष्ट — a. 1 Not nourished or fed, lean, not fat. --2 Not loud or violent, soft, low (as sound). --3 (In Rhet.) Not feeding or assisting (the meaning), irrelevant ( मुख्यानुपकारिन्), regarded as one of the arthadoshas (faults of the sense or meaning); as in the instance given under S. D. 576 विलोक्य वितते व्योम्नि विधुं मुंच रुषंप्रिये, the adjective वितत ‘expanded,’ as applied, to the sky, does not in any way help the cessation of anger and is, therefore, irrelevant.

v: apuzwatA

strI apuzwasya BAvaH tal । apuzwaduzkramagrAmyavyAhatASlIlakazwatA” ityAdinA sA॰ da॰ ukte kAvye prakftArTApozaRAkAritvarUpe arTadozaBede । yaTA “vilokya vitate vyomni viDuM muYca ruzaM priye!” ityatra vitataSabdo mAnatyAgaM prati na kiYcidupakurute iti tasya tatpozAnupakAritvAttaTAtvam apuwasya BAvaH tva । apuzwatvamapyatra na॰ । “apuzwatvaM muKyAnupakAritvamiti” sA॰ da॰ ।
